description: List the brand's saved content templates. short {id,title,category}; medium adds platforms,isFavorite,bodyPreview (160 chars); full = raw. Pass category to filter (e.g. 'hook', 'cta', 'thread'). Results are ordered by isFavorite desc, then usageCount desc.

category.description: Filter templates by category (e.g. 'hook', 'cta', 'thread'). Omit for all.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: template_list
